answer.outline: A duplicate request does not duplicate the side effect; retries are bounded; failures can be inspected and a task’s final state is recorded.
suggested_steps: Do not spawn an untracked asyncio task from a normal Flask view for durable work.
Use a persisted idempotency key or unique task identity.
Set connection/task timeouts and define poison-job handling.
